name: focused-verifiable-flow
description: Engineering principle keeping AI conversations anchored to one topic, sized for easy verification or parallel splitting, built top-down via Skeleton-First TDD, and summarized before details.
applications: **One Session, One Anchor:** Pin a canonical `Topic` on Turn 1; emit a Drift Alert and park unrelated tangents for follow-up chats rather than diluting the current thread.

**Small Verifiable Increments & Predictive Parallel Splits:** Cap single-turn work (`Small`), gate multi-step chats (`Medium â€” Steps`), or split independent modules into disjoint Parallel Conversation Packets (`Large â€” Parallel Split`).

**Contracts & Tests Before Internals (Top-Down Skeleton TDD):** Present high-level architecture first, create typed stubs (`NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on units under test), confirm tests fail RED, and implement high-to-low while peeling temporary collaborator mocks.
**Executive Summary Before Technical Details:** Present Part 1 (Summary <= 20 lines covering What, How, Verification) above Part 2 (Detailed Breakdown) on every plan and substantial response.
